ways.label: Upper Copland Valley Track, car park to the alpine basin

start.name: Car park
start.quote: Car park to Welcome Flat Hut

end.name: alpine basin
end.quote: The route ends at the alpine basin.

evidence: Follow Copland Track to Welcome Flat Hut via Architect Creek Hut.
Past Douglas Rock Hut, a marked route continues up the Copland Valley.
The route ends at the alpine basin.

doubts: Car park is not described or located. Return is not stated so shape is null. Whether the main way ends at Douglas Rock Hut or the alpine basin is a judgement; chose the basin where the page says the route ends. Scott Creek is crossed (multiple channels, no bridge mentioned).
